content.text:
If you mean **Codex/ChatGPT credits**: you can’t pool or transfer teammates’ credits to your account; they stay tied to the purchasing account and are non-transferable. Also, that account’s included allowance is used before its purchased credits. [OpenAI’s credit policy](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12642688-using-credits-for-flexible-usage-in-chatgpt-personal-plans)

With explicit organizer/account-owner approval, the account owner could sign into Codex on your PC, but Codex Desktop doesn’t support simultaneous account switching—you would need to sign out of your account first. Keep credentials private and don’t share accounts unless the hackathon rules explicitly allow it. [OpenAI account-switching guidance](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001068-use-multiple-accounts-with-account-switching)

For the hackathon, the clean setup is an organizer-issued shared workspace/API project or shared platform credential, with a spending cap. If you mean **Atira** credits rather than Codex credits, tell me where the credit appears (Atira dashboard, API provider, or Codex), and I’ll give the exact setup.

content.text:
Hackathon status: **functional core built; not ready to submit yet.**

- Challenge: QuoteCraft’s Atira “RFQ to Bid” agent.
- The original test run finished eligible with quality 100, but made **zero LLM calls**. It was only a test run, not a submission—so we are not on the leaderboard.
- The code has since been rebuilt around a model-directed, four-browser workflow, with deterministic Decimal calculation retained for the commercial rules.
- Committed coverage now includes calculation, entry point, submission behavior, and extensive browser-environment regression fixtures.
- Current tuning is staged but uncommitted: six files are improving evidence extraction, page interactions, retries, and model timing.

Remaining before a safe scored submission:

1. Make the new browser regression suite green.
2. Run a non-submitting public test and confirm real LLM calls, extraction, bid entry, TAN retrieval, and receipt capture.
3. Verify the agent on varied/unseen layouts within the 20-minute limit.
4. Commit/push the current tuning and then make an explicit scored submission.

One delivery concern: Git is aligned with `origin/main`, but Entire’s checkpoint listing temporarily could not reach its checkpoint remote. We should re-check that before the final submission so the required Entire trail is definitely visible.
